verdict: Marvell set a revenue record at $2.22B, up 22% on AI data-center demand, and turned it into $396M of GAAP profit — helped by a $14.5M tax benefit.

segments.name: Data center
segments.note: Chips for AI data centers — custom silicon, optics and Ethernet switches; 74% of all revenue.

segments.name: Communications and other
segments.note: Enterprise networking, carrier, consumer and automotive/industrial markets, combined into one group from this quarter.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Designing new data-infrastructure chips and platforms; up 7% YoY.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Selling the chips and running the company; roughly flat YoY.

opex.name: Restructuring related charges (gains), net
opex.note: Restructuring charges this quarter — severance and facility-exit costs, net of gains — versus a net gain a year ago.

otherDetail: Interest expense of $50.8M, partly offset by $28.0M of interest income and other, net — a net $22.8M non-operating expense.
oneTimers: GAAP profit is below non-GAAP profit ($396M vs $685M) mainly because GAAP includes $143.0M of stock-based compensation and $223.6M of amortization of acquired intangible assets, both excluded from non-GAAP.
The tax line was a $14.5M benefit, not a charge, in the quarter.
footerNote: Marvell guided Q1 FY27 revenue to $2.4B ±5%.

takeaways.title: Data Center set the record
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit $1.65B — 74% of the company — on AI demand, and total revenue set a record at $2.22B, capping a record $8.19B fiscal year, up 42%.

takeaways.title: Two very different profits
takeaways.text: GAAP EPS was 46 cents against 80 cents non-GAAP: $143M of stock pay and $224M of acquisition amortization sit in the GAAP column only.

takeaways.title: Solid cash generation
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $373.7M in the quarter despite a $640M jump in receivables as sales surged into the year-end.

follow100Note: Marvell kept $17.85 of every $100 — a $14.5M tax benefit added a little to what operations earned.
